name: enlace-js
description: Node/JS adapters for Enlace (@get-enlace/express, and future @get-enlace/nest, @get-enlace/fastify, ...) — each serves the OpenAPI document and the @get-enlace/ui bundle in its own ecosystem's idiomatic way. See github.com/get-enlace/enlace-ui for the canvas UI itself and the overall architecture.
